generation.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: 16:9 wide editorial cover for HECAVEX, a research article called Phishing-Infrastructure Monitoring in Lithuania: Radar's September 2026 Baseline. Original artwork, matching the restrained flat technical line illustration of the owner-approved HECAVEX Adform cover, but a DISTINCT composition from a repository-to-archive diagram. Central large circular observation lens/radar-like ring in muted teal, drawn as a crisp flat analytical instrument with two or three simple sweeping arc lines, without data plotted on it. A few grey-blue certificate/document outlines enter the ring from the left. On the right, a clean queue of overlapping document outlines and a separate magnifying-glass icon in warm pale grey suggest retained observations awaiting analyst review. A few small muted amber accents on the queue communicate pending review, never a confirmed malicious verdict. This is a metaphor for sampled certificate transparency observations and careful classification; do not depict a working product, actual monitoring architecture or a quantitative visualization. Near-black/navy background, precise grey-blue hairlines and a few thicker teal focal strokes, high contrast, refined flat 2D editorial illustration, generous empty space, one dominant circular shape readable on a small card. Clean, technical and understated. No physical desk, trays, 3D plates, glossy tiles, photorealistic materials, robots, brain icons, skulls, locks, neon bloom, decorative circuit wallpaper. No text, words, numbers, dates, labels, charts, axes, dashboards, real URLs, actual domains, maps or logos. No red threat verdicts, fake percentages, claimed coverage extent or count of malicious sites. Opaque background. Single polished finished artwork, preferably at least1600x900.

generation.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one polished editorial illustration for a practical blog guide about safely handling a suspicious SMS link. This is explicitly an illustrative fictional scene, not a screenshot or real evidence. Wide 16:9 landscape composition if available. Subject: a modern unbranded smartphone resting on a near-black desk, screen showing a single abstract message card with an intentionally unreadable short-link line and a small restrained caution marker, next to a clean physical pause token and a magnifying glass. The concept is pause before tapping and verify through a trusted route; calm and empowering, not alarmist. Phone and verification objects large enough to read in an article figure; no hands or identifiable person. Palette near-black #111416 and graphite with muted teal #55b9b1 and soft off-white highlights; restrained warm amber for the small caution marker only. Professional photographic sculptural editorial still life, realistic tactile materials, subtle side lighting, uncluttered negative space. No readable text, no actual message contents, no real URLs, no QR codes, no bank/payment/service brands, no numbers or statistics, no attack instructions, no skulls, no hooded hacker, no exaggerated neon or futuristic UI. Do not imply that this is a real incident screenshot. Opaque background. Deliver one finished image.

generation.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: wide 16:9 editorial cover for a HECAVEX threat-research article about malicious fake AI skills, GitHub README download links that are repointed to ZIP archives, and static inspection of the downloaded code. Create an ORIGINAL restrained flat technical illustration, like the visual discipline of a mature security research publication. Use the HECAVEX Adform research cover visible in context only as a STYLE reference for fine blue-grey strokes, matte dark background, schematic relationships and controlled red emphasis; do not reproduce its content or arrangement. Scene: a clean near-black/graphite plane, no 3D objects or physical set. Main visual story: one large source-code document with a small repository-branch glyph, a thin pale line reaching a simple junction, an abandoned grey path pointing to a quiet document, and a decisive red redirected path leading to a single outlined ZIP archive. At the far right, a smaller isolated inspection frame shows two file silhouettes, one with code brackets and one with a tiny binary pattern, joined to a magnifying outline, communicating static analysis rather than execution. Four or five large recognizable motifs only. Composition: elegant left-to-right editorial schematic, crisp fine linework with a few heavier focal strokes, generous space, entire diagram fits comfortably within safe margins and stays clear at thumbnail size. Palette: near-black #080d12, slate #34434c, pale grey #9aacb8, muted teal #388c87, one restrained red #dd504b. Flat 2D diagrammatic illustration with subtle print-like texture only; excellent contrast and premium technical publication finish. No text, letters, numbers, labels, real URLs, code strings, fabricated dashboards, charts, maps, logos, brand marks, skulls, hooded people, brains, robots, circuit-board wallpaper, glossy software tiles, neon tubes, dramatic lighting or depth-of-field. Symbolic editorial artwork, never a screenshot or quantitative evidence.
